_comment: CORS policy for the Cloud Storage bucket that serves the factory library. Apply it with `bun run library:upload -- --configure-bucket`, or directly with `gcloud storage buckets update gs://BUCKET --cors-file=` once this `_comment` key is stripped (the API rejects it; scripts/starter-library/upload.mjs strips it for you). Any origin may read, because the origins that need to are not enumerable: a Firebase Hosting preview channel is served from `https://<project-id>--pr-<n>-<hash>.web.app`, whose hash is minted at deploy time, and Cloud Storage matches a CORS origin as an exact string with no subdomain wildcard -- so a named list silently blocks every preview (issue #259). That costs nothing: `storage.rules` makes `library/**` world-readable and denies every other path, these are GET/HEAD only, and the requests carry no credentials, so the same bytes are already public to any `curl`. The origins that do read this in practice are `https://<project-id>.web.app`, `https://<project-id>.firebaseapp.com`, its preview channels, and `localhost:3000` in development.
